versions.content: Three kinds of DTCs There are three kinds of DTCs repre- sented as specializations of DiagnosticTroubleCode : • non OBD relevant DTCs ( DiagnosticTroubleCodeUds ) • OBD relevant DTCs ( DiagnosticTroubleCodeObd ) • J1939 [20] relevant DTCs ( DiagnosticTroubleCodeJ1939 ) Properties individual to such a DTC specialization are modeled as attributes of Di- agnosticTroubleCodeUds , DiagnosticTroubleCodeObd and Diagnostic- TroubleCodeJ1939 , respectively.
